decisions.reason: The existing image requirement already applies to every blog article, so increasing the article count does not change its per-article rules.
The additional blogs do not change the existing internal-link destinations, publication condition, or other linking rules.
Increasing the number of blog articles does not necessarily alter the approved keyword set.
The source changes the article quantity but does not change the existing topic-suggestion workflow or select additional topics.
The request for two additional blogs does not change the campaign keyword count or selected campaign keyword mapping.
The blog article-count increase does not entail a change to the backlink count or dofollow/nofollow distribution.
The source does not change the requested coverage or content of the on-page SEO progress report.
The additional blogs do not change the weekly report type or Friday delivery schedule.
The blog quantity change is independent of the requested webpage content replacement and revision target.
